admission.justification: The derived v8 ix_fts index, minimal MCP registration and 5,000-token answer bound, and bounded impact/search/records/compact-dependent query builders jointly deliver complete drafting and verification retrieval without expanding the MCP tool roster or breaking token ceilings.

guarantee: knowledge_read remains a single read-only MCP tool within role schema byte budgets and the 500-character raw description ceiling while serving deterministic Porter FTS5 live-record search, family-grouped impact, verbatim 20-record batch retrieval inside a 5,000-token bound with inline staleAnchors, and compact dependent rows backed by the derived v8 SQLite index.
title: Bounded drafting and verification queries on knowledge_read
